import os,subprocess,hashlib,json,pwd
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/srv/projects/lowcost-europa')
want='58340ef2608cbdb927a0e97bf717b0f5321c5e09'
assert p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink()
uid=p.stat().st_uid;gid=p.stat().st_gid
who=pwd.getpwuid(uid)
def drop():os.setgroups([]);os.setgid(gid);os.setuid(uid)
def git(*args,t=45):
 env={**os.environ,'HOME':who.pw_dir,'GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0','GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0','GCM_INTERACTIVE':'never'}
 try:
  x=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(p),'-C',str(p),*args],capture_output=True,timeout=t,env=env,preexec_fn=drop)
  return x.returncode,x.stdout.decode('utf8','replace').strip()
 except Exception as e:return -99,type(e).__name__
def snap():
 a=git('rev-parse','HEAD',t=10)
 b=git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no',t=15)
 c=git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard',t=15)
 return {'head':a[1],'dirty_state_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b[1].encode()).hexdigest(),'untracked_list_sha256':hashlib.sha256(c[1].encode()).hexdigest(),'dirty_count':len(b[1].splitlines()),'valid':a[0]==b[0]==c[0]==0}
r={'project':'lowcost-europa','mode':'remote fetch only, as project directory owner, no service restart','root_owner_uid':uid,'.git_owner_uid':(p/'.git').stat().st_uid,'steps':{},'success':False}

r['head_before']=pre['head'];r['dirty_before']=pre['dirty_count']
rc,txt=git('ls-remote','--heads','origin','main',t=20)
r['remote_main']=txt.split()[0] if rc==0 and txt else None
r['steps']['owner_remote_access']=rc==0 and bool(txt)
if pre['valid'] and r['remote_main']==want:
 rc,txt=git('fetch','--no-tags','origin','main',t=130)
 r['steps']['fetch_success']=rc==0
 post=snap()
 r['steps']['worktree_unchanged']=post['valid'] and post['head']==pre['head'] and post['dirty_state_sha256']==pre['dirty_state_sha256'] and post['untracked_list_sha256']==pre['untracked_list_sha256']
 rc2,ref=git('rev-parse','--verify','refs/remotes/origin/main',t=10)
 r['ref_after']=ref if rc2==0 else None
 r['steps']['origin_main_equals_github']=rc2==0 and ref==want
 if rc2==0:
  z,div=git('rev-list','--left-right','--count',pre['head']+'...'+ref,t=20)
  if z==0:r['ahead_behind_head_vs_main']=div
 r['success']=all(r['steps'].values())
else:r['reason']='SKIPPED_no_owner_access_or_remote_sha_changed'
